==============================================================================
DETECTION LIMIT — what this does and does not exclude
==============================================================================
  positions at 1-20% minor fraction : 1,781  <- the noise continuum
  positions at >= 50%               : 12  <- the real variants

  The distribution is BIMODAL, and that is the argument: a continuum of
  low-fraction calls (sequencing error plus NUMT leakage), then a small,
  sharply separated set of near-homoplasmic variants. Anything landing in
  the continuum is not callable by this method, however interesting it looks.

  🔴 This method does NOT correct for NUMTs — that needs whole-genome
  alignment with best-hit assignment, which this box cannot host. So
  heteroplasmy below ~21% is not callable here; clinical mtDNA
  pipelines reach 1-5%.

  What it DOES exclude is the class of pathogenic mtDNA variants that
  present as high-heteroplasmy disease — MELAS m.3243A>G, MERRF m.8344A>G,
  NARP/Leigh m.8993T>G/C, the LHON primaries — and every other of the
  189 ClinVar P/LP records, none of which appears above the floor.
